title: Constraint: Tic-Tac-Toe Win for X
constraints: Generate a final tic-tac-toe position that **X has just won**: X moved first, so the number of X marks is the number of O marks plus one. X has three in a row, and O has none.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Encode the 8 winning lines explicitly. X needs at least one (OR), O needs none (AND of negations).
Count marks with sums of comparisons. Cast the first term to `int` so the sum doesn't wrap.
The count rule excludes impossible positions such as a board full of X.

examples.check: X has three in a row and O does not
examples.title: valid
examples.input: X on the diagonal, O scattered
